cutover.reason: Selective handler cutover is permitted only for equivalence-proven targets; remaining handlers stay on fallback.

limits: Generated routing is ROM-bound structural evidence; per-handler cutover additionally requires an imported PASS handler-ABI equivalence proof bound to the same ROM/span.
translation_candidate only means focused CFG had no unresolved dynamic/decode issue; it is not permission to remove fallback.
dependency-boundary records a reviewed native prefix/external-call boundary and never sets equivalence_proven by itself.

Equivalent handler/callback/external-leaf proofs with dependencies cut over only when every required dependency has its own ROM-bound equivalent semantic proof and every declared required_postcondition is explicitly oracle-verified; optional evidence_spans are fingerprint-verified too.
structural_script_hit_coverage weights commands by occurrences in the imported ROM bytecode audit; it is prioritization evidence, not measured runtime frequency.
When a handler proof declares contract.flow_outcomes, the PASS oracle must report the exact same continuation set; RAM equivalence alone cannot authorize a mismatched multi-exit cutover.

When a handler proof declares contract.shared_state, the PASS oracle must report the exact same normalized shared-state ABI channels; local sprite equivalence alone cannot authorize a cutover that omitted linked/global WRAM effects.

Callback target-domain evidence authorizes routing only. Equivalent callback-abi proofs authorize semantic cutover; dependency-boundary callback proofs expose a verified external hand-off, and only routes whose selected leaf also carries an external-leaf-abi proof execute that leaf natively.
